We are short of a healing beast (We are short of a healing beast (page 22)), but he held back the curse, but he remembered what happened this time in his heart. If there is a chance, he will definitely take revenge. If he were to draw a seal map now, he would never be able to do the step of Xia Feng. So leaving, maybe it is a good thing for the cultivation world, and it is also a good thing for the cultivators. Hearing Jun Yan issued such a poisonous oath, Heiying finally took it back with complete peace of mind. After entering the realm of the starry sky, the surroundings returned to the original darkness. After lowering his head and thinking carefully, Xia Feng already had some ideas in his mind. Originally, if Li Mo was not compatible with the demon clan, she would not dare to go to the demon clan senior to ask for the life tree fruit, but if the demon clan senior was Feng Yan, that would be another matter. Feng Xiao and others only had time to push all the power they gathered above their heads, and then there was an overbearing force. It penetrated everything and entered their bodies, causing them all to vomit blood and fly away. Seeing that they were seriously injured, a respectful and inexplicable voice came from behind. Hua Jiu turned around and saw Dark Eagle with deep eyes and a black outfit. The symbol printed on the chest was the symbol of the God and Demon Temple. Ye Lingxi helped the old man deal with several people, and then she made an excuse to send her to teacher Ye Qiming's house to pay her old age. Cong Yi was not a gentleman, but he was not a good person either. He does bad things, but he doesn't do cunning things. His mentality is complex and his thoughts are many. He has thousands of reasons to stay three feet away from her, but it is undeniable that his body has been turbulent and longing for her since he let her live in Desheng Palace. "I know that boys have needs, but they still have to suppress it when necessary." Jinglei lowered her voice, after all, this matter related to her.
